Graham Allison.bio: Graham Allison is a Harvard Kennedy School professor and former U.S. Assistant Secretary of Defense, best known for 'Essence of Decision' and his work on U.S.-China great power rivalry.
Graham Allison.known_for: Harvard political scientist focused on nuclear security and Thucydides Trap analysis.

Andrew Yang.bio: Andrew Yang is an entrepreneur and political leader who popularized universal basic income in U.S. politics through his 2020 presidential campaign.
Andrew Yang.known_for: Advocating the 'Freedom Dividend' and automation-focused economic policy.

Ben Horowitz.bio: Ben Horowitz is a co-founder of venture firm Andreessen Horowitz and former CEO of Opsware, known for advising founders on leadership under pressure.
Ben Horowitz.known_for: Co-founding a16z and authoring 'The Hard Thing About Hard Things'.

Brett Adcock.bio: Brett Adcock is a serial founder behind Vettery, Archer Aviation, and Figure, building in eVTOL, humanoid robotics, and frontier AI.
Brett Adcock.known_for: Founding Figure AI and Archer Aviation in next-gen robotics and aviation.

Milton Berg.bio: Milton Berg is a veteran technical analyst and CEO of Milton Berg Advisors, specializing in market turning-point analysis for institutional investors.
Milton Berg.known_for: Decades of macro/technical work identifying equity and commodity inflection points.

Carson Block.bio: Carson Block is the founder of Muddy Waters Research, a short seller known for exposing accounting frauds in global equities.
Carson Block.known_for: Activist short-selling and forensic research at Muddy Waters.

David Sinclair.bio: David Sinclair is a Harvard Medical School geneticist whose research on sirtuins, NAD+, and epigenetics helped shape the modern science of aging.
David Sinclair.known_for: Longevity science and authoring 'Lifespan: Why We Age—and Why We Don't Have To'.

Andrew Bosworth.bio: Andrew 'Boz' Bosworth is Meta's Chief Technology Officer and head of Reality Labs, leading AR/VR and metaverse-focused computing efforts.
Andrew Bosworth.known_for: Building Facebook's News Feed and now steering Meta's AR/VR strategy.

Ray Dalio.bio: Ray Dalio is the founder of Bridgewater Associates and a macro investor known for his 'Principles' framework and work on long-term debt cycles.
Ray Dalio.known_for: Macro investing at Bridgewater and analysis of global debt cycles.
